title: ロボットプログラミングⅠ(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Robot Programming I
educationalGoal: Learn the basic algorithms and data structures that underlie reliable programs. Use this learning to create simple programs.
advice: This is a basic course of algorithms and data structures. We will cover the following topics: 1. Numerical calculation 2. Sorting and searching 3. Recursion 4. Data structure Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to bring their own laptop computers for use in exercises. Students are required to be aware of the instructor’s messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
requiredKnowledge: Beginner-level knowledge of C programming language.

activityGoals.body: Understand basic algorithms and data structures.
Create textbook example-level programs based on basic algorithms and data structures.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
